topic: How Jeff Keeps Your Email Data Off Third-Party Servers
hook: Most email AI tools quietly ship your inbox to a third-party server. Jeff doesn't.
key_points: Jeff runs locally in your terminal — no cloud middleman for your inbox
It talks directly to Google's own servers to read/send mail, nothing else
No third-party AI vendor ever sees your email content
why_it_fits: Directly addresses the #1 objection privacy-conscious developers raise about AI email tools
source_summary: Jeff is a terminal-based AI agent that connects directly to Google's APIs for email, calendar, and contacts. It does not route data through any third-party AI service — inference happens against the user's own configured model.

topic: Jeff now supports MCP integrations for connecting to any tool
hook: Jeff now speaks MCP. Point it at any MCP server and it just works.
key_points: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard, not proprietary
Jeff can connect to any MCP-compatible tool or server
why_it_fits: MCP support is a genuine new capability worth spotlighting for the developer audience
source_summary: Jeff added native support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard originally released by Anthropic. This lets Jeff connect to any MCP server without custom integration work.

topic: Why 'Runs Locally' Is Becoming a Real Buying Criterion for AI Tools
hook: A year ago 'runs locally' was a nice-to-have. Now it's a dealbreaker for a growing number of teams.
key_points: Recent high-profile data-handling incidents at major AI vendors have shifted buyer expectations
Developers increasingly ask about data residency before adopting an AI tool
Jeff was built local-first from day one, not retrofitted after the fact
why_it_fits: Connects a real industry trend to Jeff's core architectural choice without overclaiming specific incidents
source_summary: Industry discussion (Hacker News, developer Twitter) has increasingly focused on where AI tools send user data, following several publicized incidents at cloud AI vendors involving unexpected data handling.

topic: Effortless Email Mastery with Vim Shortcuts in Jeff
hook: Navigate your inbox at the speed of thought — h, j, k, l through your messages.
key_points: Jeff brings Vim-style keybindings to email navigation
Compose, reply, and archive without touching the mouse
Familiar to the large existing base of Vim/Neovim users
why_it_fits: Directly targets Jeff's core audience of terminal/Vim power users with a concrete, learnable feature
source_summary: Jeff supports Vim-style keybindings (h/j/k/l navigation, familiar modal editing commands) throughout its email interface, aimed at developers already fluent in Vim or Neovim.
